name: agentd-primer-probe-server
description: OligoSmith 引物与探针设计、验证、优化和报告生成 MCP 服务
target_platform: Linux server with Docker Engine and Compose v2

minimum_resources.database_disk: depends on mounted BLAST and FASTA resources

himat_terminal_result: JSON-RPC result is the exact primer_design_output data/type object without the CallToolResult wrapper
authentication: Bearer JWT for MCP, REST mutations, and canonical WF-02 report APIs; WF-02 attachment cards use configured RustFS public URLs with signed local fallback; read-only WF-01 deliverables are public by deployment default
persistent_state: agentd-jobs Docker volume for jobs, WF-02 background recovery state, WF-02 calculation cache, and HiMat input artifacts plus RustFS S3 publication for user attachments when enabled
external_data: NCBI Entrez live nucleotide access for P5 default housekeeping genes
optional versioned target and internal-control override FASTA files
RustFS S3 endpoint and least-privilege credentials when attachment publication is enabled
offline_note: Build on a connected Linux Docker host and run deploy/scripts/export_offline_image.sh.
